card.name: Words for banning or outlawing
card.fires_on: Words that mean to ban or forbid, such as ban, banned, outlaw, outlaws, prohibited and prohibition, in news, law and policy text. It also fires on pieces of such words, like Ban-ning or Pro-hibition.

modes.label: Ban verbs and nouns
modes.description: Forms of ban or outlaw describing a rule that stops something.
modes.example: Georgia to<< ban>> any other company using the name without permission

modes.label: Prohibit forms
modes.description: Prohibit or prohibition used for legal or religious rules.
modes.example: Pro<<hibition>> of placing illegal timber on the EU market

modes.label: Contraindication stem
modes.description: Weaker firing partway through the word contraindications.
modes.example: There are no absolute contr<<ain>>dications to the use of ragweed
